_prototype_verification: PROTOTYPE rule pack. Core parameters VERIFIED against T.C.A. § 67-4-2109 (2024 Tennessee Code, via Justia — see _sources): base Job Tax Credit = $4,500 per qualified job, statewide, for making the $500,000 required capital investment AND creating at least 25 qualified jobs (reduced to 20 jobs in a tier 3, and 10 jobs in a tier 4, enhancement county). A qualified job = a permanent position of at least 37.5 hours/week for 12 consecutive months; part-time (>=20 hrs/wk) and seasonal (>=26 wks) each count as 0.5 job. Enhancement counties (tier 2/3/4) earn an ADDITIONAL annual credit of $4,500/job for 3-5 years. Unused credit carries forward 15 years (25 years for credits earned in tax years ending on/after 12/31/2008). Per the partner (7/9/26) eligibility is STATEWIDE (no pinpointer gate); geography changes the dollar value only. The weekly-WAGE floor is NOT in the statute (it requires 37.5 hrs + minimum health care) and remains _prototype_verify pending the partner. NOTE: a post-7/1/2025 version of the statute exists; confirm the current text before client use.

credit.name: Tennessee Job Tax Credit
credit.tier: Statewide (Nashville/Davidson enhanced tier for the demo HQ)
credit.summary: Franchise and excise tax credit. STATEWIDE eligibility: create 25+ net new jobs AND invest at least $500,000 to qualify anywhere in Tennessee. Geography (enhanced counties) raises the per-job dollar value; the demo's Nashville (Davidson) headquarters sits in the enhanced tier. Retroactively available up to 15 years.

filing.window: TN Form FAE170 by franchise/excise due date

thresholds._note: Statewide test (T.C.A. § 67-4-2109(b)(1)): 25 qualified jobs AND $500,000 required capital investment qualifies anywhere in TN. Reduced job minimum in higher-distress enhancement counties: 20 jobs (tier 3), 10 jobs (tier 4). A qualified job = permanent, 37.5 hrs/wk, 12 consecutive months; part-time (>=20 hrs/wk) and seasonal (>=26 wks) each count as 0.5 job.

geography_value_tiers._note: Per T.C.A. § 67-4-2109(b)(1)(A) the base Job Tax Credit is $4,500/qualified job STATEWIDE. Enhancement counties (tier 2/3/4) earn an ADDITIONAL annual credit of $4,500/job for 3 years (tier 2) or 5 years (tier 3/4) under (b)(2), and have reduced job minimums. The base credit is what the demo Nashville HQ claims; the additional annual credit applies only if Davidson qualifies as an enhancement county in the claim year (verify against the annual DECD enhancement-county list).

benefit._note: Per-job base value $4,500 is VERIFIED against T.C.A. § 67-4-2109(b)(1)(A). Value is geography-tiered (enhancement additions), NOT an eligibility gate — eligibility is statewide.

geographic_scope._note: Eligibility is STATEWIDE (any TN county). Enhanced counties (Nashville Metro/Davidson, Memphis Metro/Shelby) do NOT gate eligibility — they raise the per-job dollar value only.
